legend.landslide.dodNote: The yearly editions for ROC 111–115 (2022–2026) increase the number of sites year by year (36→94) and are not the same set of areas; risk levels are the source's classes, with no numeric alert thresholds.
legend.landslide.areasNote: {dod} Click to see the households at risk and settlements.
legend.landslide.impactNote: Shares the yearly edition selector with the potential areas; dashed outline + light fill. {dod}
legend.landslide.highwayNote: Reports jumped about tenfold from 2018, probably because the reporting system changed, not because disasters increased; be careful with cross-year comparisons. 2026 runs only through Oct 4 and is an incomplete year; no report does not mean no incident. At low zoom they appear as a heat zone.
legend.landslide.annualRow: Landslide extent for the selected year
legend.landslide.annualZoom: Shown only at zoom 10 and above (small polygons are missing at low zoom).
legend.landslide.annualYears: Only five years are included: 2017, 2018, 2023, 2024 and 2025. 2019–2022 are not included, and 2016 and earlier use a different basis from the Forestry Bureau and are not included.
